---
name: Add an entry
about: Suggest a system, benchmark, tool or paper for the list
title: "Add: "
labels: add-entry
---

**Entry line** — in the list format, markers first:

```markdown
- {markers} [Name](primary-paper-url) - One sentence ending in a dot. ([code](repo-url))
```

**Hardware evidence** — link the paper, preprint or repository that shows the system acting on physical hardware, and point to the section or figure. Press coverage alone qualifies only for Organizations.

**Markers** — which apply, and why:

- [ ] 🔁 Closed-loop — the agent selects the next round of experiments across multiple rounds, without a human deciding between rounds. Leave unticked if the paper is ambiguous.
- [ ] 📄 Peer-reviewed publication.
- [ ] 💻 Code publicly available. Say so if availability is partial.
- [ ] ⚠️ Hardware execution not fully demonstrated — simulation-only or partial.

**Self-promotion?** Say whether you are an author or affiliated.
